note: The hand-authored registry of canonical public surfaces. The compiler derives the Run directory, sitemap, search records, and agent discovery from it. Writing posts and photographs keep their own content registries. Flags have one meaning each: run includes the route in the human directory, sitemap publishes a canonical URL, and agents includes it in machine discovery.
